title: "Re-exporting and Organizing Large Projects"

# Re-exporting and Organizing Large Projects
Re-exporting using `pub use` decouples internal module hierarchies from your public API:

```rust
mod internal {
    pub struct Engine;
    impl Engine {
        pub fn start(&self) { println!("Engine running"); }
    }
}

// Public API
pub use internal::Engine;

fn main() {
    let e = Engine;
    e.start();
}
```
